sentences.text:
THIS CRIMINAL PETITION IS FILED U/SEC.482 CR.P.C BY THE ADVOCATE FOR THE PETITIONER PRAYING THAT THIS HON'BLE COURT MAY BE PLEASED TO SET ASIDE THE ORDER DATED 10.10.2017 MADE IN SPECIAL CASE NO.43/2012 BY THE COURT OF PRINCIPAL DISTRICT AND SESSIONS JUDGE, UDUPI DISTRICT IN SPECIAL CASE NO.43/2012 ON APPLICATION FILED BY THE PETITIONER UNDER SECTION 227 OF CR.PC FOR THE OFFENCES P/U/SEC.120B, 201, 409, 418, 419, 420, 465, 466, 467, 468, 471, 472,
473, 474, 475 AND 484 R/W 34 OF IPC AND SECTION 3(1)(ix)AND 3(2)(V) OF SC/ST (POA) ACT, DISCHARGE THE PETITIONER FOR THE OFFENCES P/U/SEC. 120B, 201, 409, 418, 419, 420, 465, 466,
467, 468, 471, 472, 473, 474, 475 AND 484 R/W SECTION 34 OF IPC AND SECTION 3(1)(ix)AND 3(2)(V) OF SC/ST (POA) ACT AND ETC.

THIS CRIMINAL PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION,
THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER
Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner has filed a memo dated 21.07.2023 seeking withdrawal of the petition as the same does not survive for consideration.
2. The memo is placed on record.
3. In view of the above said memo, this criminal petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
